scope: Selected public client fields and existing-result accounting supporting the class-question review. No combat mechanics or benchmark requests were changed.

findings.qualification: Signed mask fields are interpreted as unsigned 32-bit bitsets. The earlier family table is qualified by its exact build; the current public affected-spell list corroborates the same scope.
The rank curve sets magnitude; these two records independently specify the 200-ms recovery. They do not establish every mixed-hand modifier rule.

The active enchant points to a dummy script, not directly to legacy extra-attack effect 8233. The latter is still referenced by descriptive text. This settles the data-backed ICD, not the script's attack table or rank routing.
These fields do not provide guardian melee damage, attack speed or inheritance.

The actual debuff is not the old remembered -100 AP/four-second Screech. Rank one 24423 also records a ten-second recovery. Rounding and strongest-provider handling belong in the implementation regression.
Engine duration agrees. The UI's 15-second talent prose is stale. Charge fields do not establish interrupted/in-flight consumption order.
150 is a script-effect argument, not an explicit damage-percent aura.
Blizzard explicitly confirms baseline class-buff availability. Trainer delivery and numeric effect values are separate sources.
Family eligibility and one charge do not establish when that charge is removed relative to two triggered children.

existing_result_accounting.method: Sum hits+crits+misses for the Instant/Deadly application actions and divide by iterations. Exclude Deadly tag-100 periodic ticks. Resisted-hit/crit fields are subsets, not extra applications.
existing_result_accounting.qualification: Aggregate averages, not per-iteration maxima or a guarantee against depletion. No new simulation was run.

findings.qualification: Always-hit is explicit. The description's power variable does not identify the server script's caster context. An exact 3x threat multiplier and cannot-crit rule are not established here.
School mask 36 is Fire|Shadow. Separate aura-65 effects provide 1/2/2 casting speed, not generic attack haste.

The ordinary damage-percent modifier includes spell-power damage. Its separate dummy has no declared cast-time operation. The code's base-only damage multiplier and its omitted dummy are different issues. Neither named modifier covers Blood Pact; the current talent description explicitly names only Firebolt and Fire Shield.

blood_pact_model.qualification: The current regression locks in the obsolete 30% multiplier. Passing that regression is not source verification. This review reports the discrepancy without changing the requests.

access_gaps: Hunter issues 22, 23, 35, 39, 45, 46 and 47 were fetched with their comments. Each contained a Discord-channel pointer and no public result comments. They were not counted as answered experiments.
The current client table collection spans multiple builds; no claim is made that every table was newly exported from 70009.
No finite-shard inventory, copied-damage formula or server dummy implementation was inferred merely from an external simulator.
